CHANGELOG updated in SHANKPIT: Real per-face flashlight lighting: flashlight_face_boost replaces the old flat box-wide add with a genuine N.L term per face, flashlight_sources_gather extends it to every active player's flashlight (real multiplayer), beam cone alpha cut 0.85->0.16 so the lit wall itself is the dominant visual, not the cone sprite (commit 09fbf3a) (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)
